title: Public Deliberation & Consultation Plan: National Universal Free Healthcare and Medical Integrity Bill, 2026
proposal: National Universal Free Healthcare and Medical Integrity Bill, 2026

publication.plain_language_summary: Universal free healthcare, free medicines, diagnostics, and surgeries in public facilities, private tariff capping, 15km/30km facility mandates, AI clinical auditing, and penalizing doctor kickbacks.
publication.full_draft: Draft text published on Ministry of Health portal and Gazette of India.
publication.impact_notes: Socio-economic impact assessment, health economics analysis, and fiscal memorandum.
publication.evidence_register: NSSO health rounds, WHO global health reports, ICMR study registers.

channels: Public town-hall hearings in every district
participation.accessibility: Barrier-free access, local language translation, toll-free phone recording
participation.anti_retaliation: Whistleblower protection and anonymous submission option

integrity.lobbying_disclosure: Mandatory public registration of all pharmaceutical and private hospital lobbying meetings
integrity.anti_capture: Independent multi-stakeholder advisory council overseeing public submissions
integrity.automated_analysis_disclosure: Public report on natural language processing tools used for comment categorization

deliberation.townhalls: District-level public hearings conducted by District Magistrates
deliberation.stakeholder_roundtables: Roundtables with National Medical Commission, IMA, civil society, patient groups

response_to_comments.publication: Public Redline and Submissions Outcome Matrix

remedies.reconsultation_trigger: Substantive structural revision to core statutory rights or private price-capping formulas
remedies.public_notice: Public notification in Official Gazette and national media
